const int BUF_SIZE = 1 << 16;
char buf[BUF_SIZE], *head = buf, *tail = buf;

inline char get_char() {

        int len = fread(buf, 1, BUF_SIZE, stdin);
        if (!len) { term = true; return 0; }
        tail = (head = buf) + len;
    }
    return *head++;

template<class T> inline bool read_int(T &x) {
    x = 0; char c = get_char(); bool neg = false;
    while (c < '0' || c > '9') { c = get_char(); if (c == '-') neg = true; if (term) return false; }
    while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') { x = x * 10 + c - '0'; c = get_char(); }
    if (neg) x = -x;
    return true;

inline bool read_str(char *s) {

    while (c >= 33 && c <= 126) { *s++ = c; c = get_char(); }
    *s = 0;

template<class T> inline void print_int(T x, char end) {
    if (!x) { putchar('0'); putchar(end); return; }
    if (x < 0) { putchar('-'); x = -x; }
    int m = 0, a[10];
    while (x) { a[m++] = x % 10; x /= 10; }

    int res = 1;
    while (y) {
        if (y & 1) res = (long long)res * x % mod;
        x = (long long)x * x % mod;
        y >>= 1;

    ifac[n] = power(fac[n], mod - 2);
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 1; --i) ifac[i] = (long long)ifac[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod;
    ifac[0] = 1;

    auto C = [&](int x, int y) -> int {
        if (y < 0 || y > x) return 0;
